sentiment.rationale: Guidance was raised materially: full-year constant-currency net sales guidance increased from 3.75%-4.75% to 4.8%-5.1%, and adjusted operating income guidance increased from 3.5%-5.5% to 4.8%-5.5%. The raise is organic, driven by strong operational momentum across segments, eCommerce growth, and market share gains, not primarily attributed to FX or one-time items. Management language is confident, with no meaningful risks raised that would offset the positive forward signal.

summary.revenue: Total revenues of $179.5 billion, up 5.8% (6.0% in constant currency). Consolidated net sales of $177.8 billion, up 5.8% (5.9% cc).
summary.eps: Adjusted EPS of $0.62, up 6.9% year-over-year. GAAP EPS of $0.77.
summary.guidance: Full-year constant-currency net sales growth raised to 4.8%-5.1% (from 3.75%-4.75%). Full-year constant-currency adjusted operating income growth raised to 4.8%-5.5% (from 3.5%-5.5%). Adjusted EPS expected to be $2.58-$2.63.
summary.margin: Consolidated gross profit rate was 24.2%, up 2 bps year-over-year. Walmart U.S. gross profit rate increased 19 bps. Adjusted operating expenses as a percentage of net sales leveraged 4 bps. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 6.1%, up ~20 bps.
key_risks: Lower-income households under additional pressure, with some moderation in spending in that cohort.
Merchandise category mix headwind to gross margin, as grocery and health & wellness outpace general merchandise.
Maximum fair pricing legislation effective January 2026 will affect health & wellness/pharmacy business comps.
Approximately 150 bps of headwinds from VIZIO acquisition and lapping leap year.
Tariff and trade policy uncertainty, though less impact than initially expected.
key_opportunities: eCommerce growth of 27% globally, with each segment above 20%.
Global advertising business up 53% (including VIZIO), Walmart Connect up 33%.
Membership income up 17% globally, with Walmart+ net adds at strongest on record.
Supply chain automation: >60% of stores receive freight from automated DCs, >50% of eCommerce fulfillment center volume automated, driving lower shipping costs.
AI and technology driving efficiency, with >40% of new code AI-generated or AI-assisted.
Market share gains across grocery, general merchandise, and higher-income households.
International segment strong, with 11.4% constant-currency sales growth and 16.9% adjusted operating income growth.
Partnership with OpenAI and digital agent 'Sparky' enhancing customer experience.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Doug McMillon stated 'I'm as excited about the future of this company as I've ever been' and John David Rainey said 'we're playing offense, accelerating our growth,' reflecting strong confidence in the forward trajectory.
